problem: PHASE-004 would otherwise choose a canonical target without artifact evidence, and the repository held three uninspected inputs that PHASE-001 explicitly refused to judge: the R8 resource package, KIDS_PACKAGE_candidate_2 and the current canonical Access representation. Without a comparative audit the design would either copy the newest artifact or rediscover, one defect at a time, capabilities that already exist in an older one.
scope: Read-only comparative audit of seven artifacts and the materialization of its result: two new knowledge artifacts, the judgement of REC-CONSOLIDATION section 15's three artifact inputs, one work item, and control-plane state. No artifact was selected as canonical, no architecture was designed, no schema or persistence strategy was chosen, and no application code, migration, contract or legacy mechanism was touched.
layer: Control policy and repository knowledge governance
baseline: b46c0438d4927851fcd688a8a8e71468aba6cf18 on security/hardening-2; target platform/apps/geostat/backend/api unchanged at 26 modified / 29 untracked. Source artifacts were copied to a scratch directory and opened with Jackcess in read-only mode; SHA-256 of every source artifact is unchanged after inspection. The AIR register still carries another author's 95 uncommitted lines and was again not edited, so AIR-2026-056 stays reserved in TASK-002.
reuse: Two artifacts were created because no owner existed for judging artifacts: AUD-COMPARATIVE for the comparison and AUD-CAPABILITY for the capability register and design input package. Everything they touch that already has an owner is cited, never restated: findings and requirements stay in REC-CONSOLIDATION, authority in DOC-CAD, criteria in STD-BENCH-001, automation classes in STD-AUTO-001, layer coverage in REC-COVERAGE. REC-CONSOLIDATION section 15 was updated in place rather than copied, because it owns the pending-input list. No finding discovered during the audit was re-registered in a new findings register.
impact: PHASE-004 can start with an evidence package instead of a preference. Three results change what design must assume: no artifact passes the STD-BENCH-001 invariant gate, so the canonical model is not a copy of any of them; candidate_2 implements the per-combination constant declaration that PHASE-001 recorded as REQUIRED-BUT-MISSING (CF-015); and eleven capabilities are absent from every artifact. Two artifact-level facts were measured rather than assumed: the R8 package manifest verifies 451 of 451 digests with zero dangling edges, and two files sharing one name and one declared identity are byte-different and semantically identical, which retires byte digests as a correspondence mechanism.
compatibility: No runtime contract, schema, migration, API surface, package or deployment artifact is affected, and no source artifact was modified - digests are unchanged before and after. The two new documents are additive; the only pre-existing artifact edited is REC-CONSOLIDATION, which gains a dated subsection under its own section 15 and loses nothing. One change record was superseded rather than rewritten: phase-002-acceptance-review now carries supersededBy this card, because PHASE-003 edited four control-plane files it covered.
failure: Both validators fail closed and run in CI: a dangling reference, a duplicate canonical owner, a stale digest or an uncovered changed path exits non-zero and blocks the claim. The audit's own failure mode is over-claiming, and it is bounded by method: every quantitative statement was recomputed (digests, value multisets, edge resolution, duplicate grain checks) and every attractive hypothesis was recorded with its falsification attempt and confidence. Rollback is textual: delete the two documents, this card and evidence directory and the work item, and revert the REC-CONSOLIDATION subsection and the control-plane edits.
security: No credential, database, network, CI or deployment surface is touched. Artifacts were opened read-only from copies; the reader executes nothing it finds in them. The audit records that A-R8 and A-CAND2 both assert approval state inside a transport artifact, which is a trust-boundary defect already owned as CF-033/CF-034 - it is reported, not changed.

GOV-001.reason: Existing owners were inspected before creating anything; the two new artifacts own a responsibility (judging artifacts) that no register held, and every fact they touch cites its owner.

GOV-002.reason: The audit traces each artifact through producer, contract self-description, raw and canonical planes, package boundary and presentation declarations, and records which boundaries it deliberately did not judge.

GOV-003.reason: TASK-004 records scope, method, what was not inspected and why, and the handoff; unrelated dirty work is preserved and named.

GOV-004.reason: Two artifacts rather than one per required-deliverable item: comparison and capability register have different consumers and lifecycles, and the thirteen required outputs map onto them without redundant documents.

ARC-001.reason: Responsibility classification precedes comparison, so no artifact is penalised for not being something it never claimed to be; the two new CATALOG rows declare distinct ownership and RCP-404 passes.

ARC-002.reason: The audit evaluates artifact provenance, retention and replay properties directly: raw envelope, derivation chain, package digests and re-derivability are each measured against BM-INV-23.

SEC-002.reason: No secret, credential, upload or fetch destination is involved; artifacts were read from local copies.

EVO-001.reason: Loss analysis covers every transition in the lineage and classifies each disappearance; one UNRESOLVED loss is named rather than smoothed over.

OBS-001.reason: Every verdict names the evidence that produced it, and the audit's residual weakness - one provider, one cube, five candidates - is stated in its own exit test.

TST-001.reason: No test was weakened or removed. The audit added verification of its own claims instead: 451 digests, 880 values, 0 dangling edges, 0 duplicate grain triples.

TST-002.reason: Commands, environment and exit codes are in the evidence bundle, and each performance statement is labelled PROVEN, MEASURED, STRUCTURALLY LIKELY or UNKNOWN; nothing is claimed as measured that was not.

SCH-001.reason: No meta-schema, grammar or contract is declared or altered; the audit reads declarations and does not change the authority chain.

SCH-002.reason: Concept-level comparison is the audit's core: grain, identity, dimensions, measures, units, statuses and classifiers are compared as declared semantics, and each artifact's declared grain is checked against its enforced key.

SCH-003.reason: Site-name leakage into generic families was counted per artifact (3 in A-R8, 0 in A-CAND2), and the audit records that generality is evidenced for one provider and one cube only.

ING-001.reason: No ingestion path is exercised; no artifact was loaded, imported or admitted anywhere.

DAT-001.reason: No canonical table, constraint, tenant scope or snapshot is created or modified.

DAT-002.reason: No retry, transaction, timeout or idempotency behaviour exists in a read-only inspection.

API-001.reason: No request, response, projection or query plan is added or changed.

UI-001.reason: No page, view, chart, map, export or locale is declared or altered; presentation declarations were read as evidence only.

SEC-001.reason: No authentication, authorization, tenancy or execution boundary exists in a read-only document audit.

REL-001.reason: No release surface, image, migration or provenance artifact is affected, and this card claims no release readiness.

handoff: PHASE-003 is COMPLETE and GATE-COMPARATIVE is PASS. The next permitted phase is PHASE-004, Canonical Design, behind GATE-DESIGN-ENTRY, whose every listed check now passes; it has not been started. Design consumes AUD-CAPABILITY section 5 - must preserve, must eliminate, must reconcile, must add, provider-specific, open decisions - and not the artifacts themselves. Three inherited facts shape it: no artifact passes the invariant gate, so the target copies none of them; candidate_2's attribute attachment levels implement CF-015, which recovery recorded as missing, so the shape exists to reuse; and eleven capabilities (CAP-M01..M11) are absent from every artifact, so recombination is not sufficient. Three owner decisions are now due rather than pending: TASK-002 (DEF-08), BM-Q-01 SDMX conformance level and BM-Q-02 whether Access is permanent. Five comparative questions AQ-01..AQ-05 are carried into design. The audit's own weakest point is stated in its exit test: one provider and one cube were examined, so SCH-003-style generality rests on a single case.
